materiality_rule: A selection or rationale defect is material when changing or omitting it could change feasible-set membership, required authority or preconditions, or the next permitted action.

clauses.pass_condition: Every material premise and selected plan term matches the current fact-owning actor-visible source: customer requirements govern the order, inventory governs availability, quotes govern their terms, effect records govern completed work, and approval records govern authorized mutations.

Missing, stale, inaccessible, expired, identity-mismatched, or equally authoritative conflicting requirements, stock, quote, effect, or authority evidence remains uncertain and cannot be used as a satisfied feasibility premise; evaluator-only truth cannot rescue unsupported certainty.

The selection and rationale preserve every hard constraint, whole-order term, source and quote identity, required operation, precondition, current authority dependency, and unresolved blocker needed to distinguish feasible from infeasible recovery; after reservation they use the confirmed reservation rather than demand the same unreserved inventory again.

When the deterministic feasible set is nonempty, the Planner may select any member and identifies the next permitted action, including required approval; when feasibility is empty or genuinely unresolved, it identifies the actual blocker and next permitted clarification or escalation. Refusal or escalation merely to avoid a supported feasible choice fails.

Best, cheapest, fastest, unique-choice, or guaranteed-outcome claims appear only when a declared objective and the complete current feasible set support them; quoted cost and arrival estimates remain estimates rather than promises.
